quotes.text: Chaos, when left alone, tends to multiply.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.text: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: All great changes are preceded by chaos.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra

quotes.text: In all chaos there is a cosmos, in all disorder a secret order.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.text: If you flip a coin three times and it lands on heads each time, it's probably chance.
quotes.author: T. Colin Campbell

quotes.text: Random chance plays a huge part in everybody's life.
quotes.author: Gary Gygax
